title: ITVX / Drama at the bus shelter
slide_intent: Anchor programme imagery with a repeated framing cue and service signature, because viewers need to recognize the same service across different situations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen continuity between campaign recognition and service use.
demonstration: A woman in a red dress fills a portrait bus-shelter display. Yellow arrows frame the programme title and ITVX sits near the bottom.
practical_value: Anchor programme imagery with a repeated framing cue and service signature.

content_islands.name: Shelter
content_islands.spec: The surrounding dark street gives the lit poster contrast.

content_islands.name: Portrait
content_islands.spec: The actor occupies most of the display.

content_islands.name: Signatures
content_islands.spec: Title, arrows and service logo provide layered identification.
